dossier.summary: Fernway sells scheduling and visit tracking software to home care agencies. Caregivers clock in and pick up open shifts from their phone, and office staff see every visit on one screen. A case study on the site says Brightpath Home Care cut unfilled shifts by a third in its first quarter. Willow Lane Senior Services is also named as a customer.
dossier.why_now: Opened a Texas office in August and is hiring its first two account executives.
dossier.angle: Agencies that grow past one office start losing shifts to phone tag.

audience.summary: Owners and operations leads at home care agencies in Texas with 20 to 500 staff. They are the ones who get the call when a visit has no caregiver. I left out hospital systems, since they buy through procurement and want something else.

data.headline: Six people who should hear about Fernway first
data.intro: With the new Texas office, I went looking for home care agencies there that look like Brightpath and Willow Lane. Below are the six people I would email first, and the opening email for three of them. It's a first pass, so tell me what you would change.

shortlist.name: Rosa Delgado
shortlist.title: Owner
shortlist.why: Owns the agency, so she feels every unfilled visit and signs off on new software.

shortlist.name: Marcus Bell
shortlist.title: Director of Operations
shortlist.why: Runs operations, so open shifts and late clock-ins land on his desk.

shortlist.name: Priya Raman
shortlist.title: Scheduling Manager
shortlist.why: Filling shifts is her whole job. She would use Fernway every day.

shortlist.name: Tom Whitaker
shortlist.title: Administrator
shortlist.why: At a smaller agency the administrator often still builds the schedule by hand.

shortlist.name: Alicia Moreno
shortlist.title: VP of Operations
shortlist.why: Owns operations across a larger agency, where scheduling by phone starts to break.

shortlist.name: Grant Holloway
shortlist.title: Owner
shortlist.why: Owner of a growing agency, close to the size where Brightpath started.

emails.name: Rosa Delgado
emails.title: Owner
emails.subject: Open shifts at Lone Star
